name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated demo system, order 1001 for the George Russell team cap shows as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or a 30-day exchange at the official store at shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Okay, thank you for the information. I will look into the replacement process on the website.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. If you need anything else while you are at the official store at shop.mercedesamgf1.com, just let me know. Go Silver Arrows!
User: event: conversation_ended
Agent Action: Call Tool end_session with args {'reason': 'The user has ended the conversation.', 'session_escalated': False}

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the order status, damaged-item guidance, and the necessary mock disclosure; the user has acknowledged the resolution.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool for order #1001 and correctly identified the status as 'Delivered' with tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent clearly explained that the user is eligible for a free replacement or a 30-day exchange for the damaged item.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly stated, 'In our simulated demo system,' at the beginning of the response and included the disclaimer information from the tool output confirming the data is mocked.
